description: Use for any question about incident or breach reporting deadlines in the EU (for example 'how long do we have to report a breach / a cyber incident?'). Lists who must report what, to whom and by when under GDPR (personal data breaches), NIS2 (significant incidents), DORA (major ICT-related incidents at financial entities) and the Cyber Resilience Act (actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents), with the article for each deadline and when the clock starts.

regimes.description: Limit to these regimes; omit for all
